description.text: ENTERANCE EXAMINATIONS Time: Based on the Admission Notice published Content of Test: Interview (language and specialized background knowledge) TUITION AND FEES 1. Application fee: RMB 660 2. Tuition fees Majors offered in English: RMB 70,000 (RMB2,680/per credit ) (First year RMB 36,000, second year RMB 22,000, third year RMB 6,000, fourth year RMB 6,000)

duration.text: The International Marketing at University of International Business and Economics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 9722 USD/In total ￥ 70000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Highschool's degree diploma Highschool certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of highschool schoolUIBE Application Form (Required to fill out online) 5.A copy of TOEFL 90 above or IELTS 6.0 above 6.Two reference letters from the applicant's professors 7.A copy of master thesis or other published thesis required for Doctoral Programs 8.UIBE Application Form (Required to fill out online)

requirements.text: Master's degree, Good health, Corresponding high language proficiency (English)
